analogy.rationale: Caspase activators directly trigger apoptosis, a program these cell lines can execute, but the transcriptional signature of caspase activation is modest and largely overlaps with other apoptosis inducers such as BCL inhibitors and oxidative stress inducers. Most reference classes act on pathways not shared with caspase activation, so the expected response is weak.
